intendedUse.answers: Locations in a chest CT series where a radiologist would likely have marked a nodule, offered as candidates for review.
intendedUse.doesNotAnswer: Whether a nodule is malignant, whether the patient has cancer, and how large a nodule is. Malignancy is a separate model with its own evidence; size is P3.
intendedUse.route: Candidate generator for the existing lung nodule characteriser. Never an autonomous output.

predictedEvent.definition: P(a radiologist marked a nodule at this location | this candidate)

dataset.name: LIDC-IDRI
dataset.$seriesAvailableLocallyCorrection: This field previously read 228 series. 228 is the PATIENT count; 229 series are on disk, one patient having two. Measured by scripts/lidc_series_availability.py.

localAvailabilityIsAThirdOfTheSplit.note: The split assigns all 748 series in the label table. 229 have pixel data here, so the usable size of every split is smaller than its assigned size, and it is the usable size that sets interval width.
localAvailabilityIsAThirdOfTheSplit.consequenceForTheProposedGate: On the 126 test nodules available here, an observed sensitivity of 0.849 carries a 95% Wilson interval of 0.776-0.901 and an observed 0.897 carries 0.832-0.939. A 0.85 bar cannot be DEMONSTRATED as met at this sample size. See docs/P2_TRAINING_FEASIBILITY.md.

dataset.labelProvenance: Radiologist malignancy ratings and ROI centroids, clustered across up to four readers. Impressions, not histology.

luna16.ifUsed: Overlap with local LIDC series must be excluded before evaluation, joined on SOURCE SeriesInstanceUIDs from the dataset manifests. The platform's stored UIDs are salted HMAC remaps and must not be the join key.

splits.strategy: Train, validation, calibration and test mutually patient-disjoint. Manifest and seed committed before training.
splits.method: HMAC-SHA256(seed, source LIDC patient id) -> [0,1), compared against cumulative bounds. Adding a patient moves only that patient, so two training runs stay comparable.
splits.leakageAudit: clean — no patient, series or nodule in more than one split. Re-derived independently by audit_splits and reproducible with: python scripts/lidc_build_splits.py --audit-only
splits.classBalanceIsNotStratified: Malignant share runs from 30.3% (validation) to 41.1% (calibration). Assignment is hashed on patient identity and does not balance labels; stratifying would destroy the stability property above. Evaluation must account for this rather than assume matched prevalence.
splits.note: The manifest fixes WHO is in which set, before anyone can see a result and be tempted to move the line. It is not a measurement, and no detector has been trained on it.

preprocessing.version: detect-hu-v1 — INITIAL ENGINEERING DEFAULT, not empirically selected (inference/detection_preprocess.py; training/configs/lung_nodule_detector.yaml)
preprocessing.note: Detector preprocessing is HU-based and is NOT the 8-bit lung-windowed render the characteriser uses (CT_LUNG_WINDOW -600/1500 in inference/dicom_ingest.py). Reusing that render for a detector would repeat the class of defect that withdrew the legacy lung model.

metrics.primary: per-nodule sensitivity at a stated false-positives-per-scan operating point

localisationTolerance.proposedRule: A candidate matches a reference nodule when its centre lies within the reference nodule's radius.
localisationTolerance.blockedBy: The matching rule itself is undecided. The data blocker is cleared — scripts/lidc_extract_diameters.py measures 995 nodules across 207 series in three conventions — but which convention, which floor, and how duplicate and ambiguous matches resolve are owner decisions, recorded as STATUS: PENDING in docs/P2_LOCALIZATION_METHODOLOGY.md.
localisationTolerance.note: Any sensitivity figure quoted without a defined localisation tolerance is not interpretable.

stratificationNotPossible.demographics: LIDC records sex for 29% of patients, age for 20%, ethnic group for 4%. A demographic breakdown is not possible from this dataset and must be reported as such rather than omitted.

proposedGate.status: PROPOSED — REQUIRES PROJECT DECISION OR EXTERNAL BENCHMARK JUSTIFICATION
proposedGate.source: Appears as an example ('e.g.') in docs/AUDIT_AND_ROADMAP_2026-09-20.md Part B2.
proposedGate.ifMissed: Do not ship candidates. The roadmap's stated fallback is that P2 stops at 'candidates not shown' and the pipeline stays at route 1. Lowering the bar after measuring is not an option.

calibration.method: temperature scaling, as scripts/calibrate-model.py already implements

ood.requirement: Both directions, with pre-set bars, as scripts/build-ood-reference.py already enforces.
refuseDomains: series failing the geometry or quality gate
ood.note: The characteriser's reference is fitted on 224x224 RGB patch features and cannot be reused for volumes.

evaluationMachinery.status: IMPLEMENTED AND UNIT-TESTED ON SYNTHETIC GEOMETRY
evaluationMachinery.refusesWithoutAnApprovedRule: rule_from_bar raises MethodologyUndecided while localisationTolerance.status is not APPROVED, so the pre-registration cannot be bypassed by an evaluator supplying its own tolerance.
evaluationMachinery.note: Engineering readiness. NOT model performance, NOT validation, NOT evidence that any figure can be produced.

trainingHarness.status: IMPLEMENTED — READY FOR GPU EXECUTION — NOT EXECUTED
trainingHarness.dryRunOnThisMachine: exit 3: harness ready, environment not available
trainingHarness.configurationStatus: INITIAL_ENGINEERING_DEFAULT — no value selected by measurement
trainingHarness.modelSelection: validation loss only; no detection metric computed
trainingHarness.lungMaskVersion: lung-threshold-v4 — NOT APPROVED. v3 filled the body in 10 of 20 series; v4 restricts the lung band to the body and removes that on 30 train/validation series. See docs/P2_LUNG_MASK_VALIDATION.md section 12
trainingHarness.note: Infrastructure only. Nothing here is a result, a validation or an approval.

trainingFeasibility.gpu: none — torch 2.1.0+cpu, torch.cuda.is_available() False, 0 CUDA devices, Intel Iris Xe integrated
trainingFeasibility.measuredThroughput: 2.3 patches/second on a 69,953-parameter toy 3D backbone at 96^3, batch 4
trainingFeasibility.conclusion: A detector cannot be trained on this hardware. Any P2 plan assuming training must first name where the compute comes from.
